title: capsella hians
intro: Capsella hians, commonly known as Shepherd's Purse, is a flowering plant species in the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to help reduce inflammation, improve blood clotting, and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Capsella hians include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as wounds, bruises, and menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of Capsella hians include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
